featured_reviews.name: Note from Travelam
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visiting the Mumbai Dabbawala collection point near the railway station was one of the most fascinating experiences of my Mumbai trip. Watching thousands of lunch boxes being sorted, grouped, and dispatched with remarkable precision was truly impressive.

Our guide explained the entire system in detail, from the collection of home-cooked meals to the complex sorting process and their timely delivery across the city. What amazed me most was how this world-famous network operates with such efficiency, accuracy, and coordination, largely without the use of advanced technology.

The dedication, discipline, and teamwork of the Dabbawalas are inspiring. Seeing this unique logistics system in action gave me a whole new appreciation for the people who keep Mumbai moving every day. A highly recommended experience for anyone visiting Mumbai and wanting to understand the city’s incredible work culture and spirit.

featured_reviews.name: macedonboy
featured_reviews.review_text:
This statue stands in tribute to the Dabbawala, the lunchbox delivery men of India who deliver lunch from restaurants to people's homes and workplaces.

The sculpture is made up of disks to form a structure of a stereotypical Dabbawala carrying a tiffin box in both arms. The sculpture is a fun and wonderful monument to the ordinary man. The statue is close the the famous Haji Ali Mosque and is worth a detour if you can spare 10 minutes.

featured_reviews.name: Sukumar Rajage
featured_reviews.review_text:

Mumbai's Dabbawalas are world famous for their timely delivery and immaculate service. Their business model even piqued the interest of Harvard Business School compelling professors to study their distinctive business model.
The 13-foot long statue, designed of stainless steel discs by Mumbai-based sculptor Valay Shende, was unveiled at Haji Ali on Friday. The installation is part of a private art foundation in partnership with Mumbai's municipal corporation.

featured_reviews.name: MILAN ZATAKIA
featured_reviews.review_text: A piece of Mumbai history. The famous dabbawallahs are none other than the lunch tiffin carriers who have an amazing network of delivery men who use the local railway network to deliver hot meals from Customer residences to their offices in every nook and corner of Mumbai. Global universities like Harvard and IIMA have conducted studies on the efficiency of this business model. Prince Charles of England too was very impressed with this operation. It is only befitting for this concept to be honoured with a statue at a strategic junction like haji Ali,  the Gateway to South Mumbai. Truly remarkable.

featured_reviews.name: Pravin Kumar Panjiyar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Mumbai's Dabbawalas are world famous for their timely delivery and immaculate service. Their business model even piqued the interest of Harvard Business School compelling professors to study their distinctive business model.

Heck, they have also been honoured by the British royal family!

And now, after decades of ferrying delicious and hygienically cooked food to thousands of Mumbaikars from homes to offices, the Dabbawalas get their very own art installation, in the form of a statue of a Dabbawala, standing tall and proud, readying himself to deliver the tiffin.

The 13-foot long statue, designed of stainless steel discs by Mumbai-based sculptor Valay Shende, was unveiled at Haji Ali on Friday. The installation is part of a private art foundation in partnership with Mumbai's municipal corporation.

featured_reviews.name: Vishal Desai
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

We've been ordering the Non-Veg Standard tiffin from Digitiffin while our regular cook is on leave, and the experience has been consistently excellent.

Each meal is generous and thoughtfully put together, typically including a non-vegetarian curry, dal, rice or pulao, 4 chapatis, and a fresh salad. Everything tastes homemade, fresh, and hygienic, with very little oil used in the cooking.

What really stands out is the variety. They regularly update their menu through WhatsApp status and, true to their promise, don't keep repeating the same dishes. Some memorable meals have included chicken gravy, egg curry, Punjabi kadhi with koftas, and fragrant white pulao.

The food quality has been consistently good, deliveries are reliable, and the North Indian flavours are excellent.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for a fresh, homemade tiffin service in the Malad to Churchgate area.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Hi Vishal,

featured_reviews.name: Nilima Chudasama
featured_reviews.review_text:
HIGHLY DISGUSTING BEHAVIOUR AND FOOD! DO NOT RECOMMEND AT ALL!!! I took a trial for the first time and the cabbage sabzi was sooo bitter I couldn’t even eat it and had to throw it away. I still chose to give a second chance and ask for one more trial as they generally give 3 trails.
I had a medical emergency and asked them to deliver my tiffin last to that I can be home by then from the doctor or to cancel it. The person was sooo rude and unprofessional while I kept my cool and try to talk nicely to which she still said then dont order from us next time and hung up the call on my face while I was talking. HIGHLY UNPROFESSIONAL AND MANNERLESS PEOPLE !! HORRIBLE FOOD TOO
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
We strongly disagree with this review as it does not accurately represent what happened.

You requested a trial meal and specifically asked to pay in cash upon delivery. As a policy, we normally take advance payment because food is freshly prepared based on confirmed orders and last minute cancellations result in food wastage. However, we made an exception in your case and accepted your request.

The meal had already been prepared and dispatched when you informed us that you wanted to cancel. Unfortunately, at that stage the food could not be reassigned and went to waste.

Regarding the food quality, thousands of meals are served through our Homemade tiffin service every month and we maintain consistently high ratings across multiple platforms. Taste preferences can vary from person to person, but describing our entire Homemade food service as "horrible" based on a single dish is unfair and misleading.

We always try our best to accommodate customer requests but we also expect customers to respect the time, effort and resources involved in preparing fresh food. We wish you the very best.

featured_reviews.name: Derrick D'Souza
featured_reviews.review_text:
After my wife's inability to cook due to orthopaedic issues, I was scanning the mobile for some outside caterer to fill in the void. And my eyes happened to see the food app " Tiffinkart " which instaneously caught my attention. I was not on the wrong track when I made my choice and both of us, decided to try out this catering avenue.
I got in touch with Mrs Sharmila and after a brief discussion about the rates and menu to go with, hit on her Tiffinkart app to get her to deliver food for us at our residence.
On the very first day of receiving her tiffin (one veg, the other non veg) we were delighted to see such mouth watering fare, vis-a-vis the price attached to it. oHer food is very tasty, and delicious and easily digestable. This Lady is very accommodating, kind, gentle and understanding towards the need of the hour.
However, my interaction with her made me feel like she is a family member. This is an added quality to the food she serves. No wonder a clientele stretches from Churchgate to Virar as far as I know.
Its amazing how this young, charming lady can meet the needs of those in need of good food to feed themselves.
My to all is that I have tried, tested and am still enjoying the meals coming from her gracious kitchen.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently tried Tiffinkart and was wowed by the quality of their food. Both the veg and non-veg options were flavorful and perfectly prepared. Each dish reflected great care and quality, arriving at the perfect temperature.

A special thanks to Shreeya, the owner, whose proactive approach added to the wonderful experience. Her attention to service and detail truly stands out, ensuring everything was just right.

For anyone seeking delicious and reliable meals, Tiffinkart is a fantastic choice. I highly recommend them for their exceptional food and service.
